exposure: adherence to WHO maternal antibiotic prophylaxis guidelines
cohort: The study included 23,016 women who gave birth between January 1, 2018, and December 31, 2020, from four hospitals providing maternity care in New South Wales, Australia.
finding: Demographic and labour/birth factors increased the risk of maternal pyrexia, infection, or sepsis, while adherence to WHO prophylaxis guidelines was poorly documented and high rates of antibiotic resistance to erythromycin and clindamycin were observed.
mod_finding: Emergency Caesarean section and instrumental vaginal birth were associated with an increased risk of maternal pyrexia, infection, or sepsis.
